blocks.content: **な-adjectives** behave more like nouns than adjectives. They need **な** when directly modifying a noun, but conjugate by changing the following です : the adjective stem itself never changes.

left.label: Before a noun
left.description: Insert な between the adjective and the noun it modifies.

right.label: As a predicate
right.description: Use + です directly. No な needed after the adjective.

rows.japanese: 静かじゃなかったです

rows.romaji: Kanojo wa shinsetsu na hito desu.

rows.japanese: 部屋はきれいじゃないです。
rows.romaji: Heya wa kirei ja nai desu.

rows.japanese: この仕事は大変でした。

blocks.content: Not all adjectives ending in い are い-adjectives. きれい (beautiful), きらい (disliked), ゆうめい (famous) are all な-adjectives : they end in the *sound* い but conjugate like な-adjectives. When in doubt, check a dictionary.
